svg.title: Financial Report Analyzer — AWS architecture
svg.desc: Realistic architecture: API Gateway triggers one main Lambda that calls Textract, OpenSearch, SageMaker, and writes report.html to S3.

g.text: OCR · extracts all text · up to ~3,000 sentences · returns structured blocks
full-text index · keyword search per metric · 3,000 → 100 candidates
ml.m5.xlarge · Accuracy 0.797 · Macro F1 0.737 · returns Top-3 + confidence scores
